title: SkyHarbor assistant integration — raw onramp notes
body:
Call summary:
- 2026-01-29 discovery call (45m) with SkyHarbor Insights (retail analytics)
- Primary ask: deploy an internal assistant that answers product-catalog and order-status questions for merchandising and sales ops teams. They want private deployment in their AWS VPC (no egress for catalog data).
- Key stakeholders: Marcus Leyton (CTO), Naomi Ruiz (Head of Data), Tom Huang (SRE lead), Priya Menon (Security/Compliance).

Context and constraints:
- Data: ~12M product records + transactional meta, nightly deltas. Some vendor PII (contact emails/phone) that must be redacted from model outputs.
- Query profile: hybrid semantic search + generation. Typical request pattern: single-turn Q&A (catalog lookup), occasional multi-turn clarifications. Average tokens requested: ~80–220 tokens; long answers rarely exceed 800 tokens. Expected baseline QPS: 12 qps steady, peak 120 qps during BOD (2x promotions).
- Latency target: p95 < 400ms for lookup/generation on their UI (desktop), p95 < 250ms preferred for simple catalog lookups.
- Throughput requirement argues for dedicated capacity, but budget-conscious. They asked about Dedicated vs Private options.
- Compliance: SOC2 + customer contract requires key management (HSM/KMS) and audit logs retained for 90 days. No external telemetry containing raw catalog rows.
- Connectivity: VPC peering + PrivateLink is preferred. They use an internal vector DB (Weaviate) and expect Redwood to call it over private networking.

Immediate technical notes / gotchas observed on call:
1) Tokenization mismatch risk: their ingestion pipeline uses a custom tokenizer for SKU parsing — align chunking with model tokenizer to avoid off-bytes and truncated contexts.
2) Embedding dims: their current embeddings (open-source transformer) are 768-d; we need to recommend compatible model or run an embedding migration.
3) Vector DB cold-start: during peak, we saw a pattern where embedding caching + KV prefix caching matters; suggest prefix caching for repeated catalog lookups (top-500 SKUs).
4) Firewall/TLS inspection: their security team runs HTTPS inspection appliances that have previously broken streaming responses for other vendors. Recommend synchronous non-streaming endpoints for initial rollout.
5) Quantization tradeoffs: they are price-sensitive and asked about 4-bit quantized variants; warn about generation quality regressions for long contextual prompts (documented with examples).
6) Function/tool calling: they want strict suppression of PII in generated text; propose a tool-call (sanitizer) that receives candidate outputs and redacts according to patterns before returning to user.
7) Fallback policy: they prefer private-only for sensitive content but are open to fallback to hosted verified model for non-sensitive queries during capacity saturation. Need legal sign-off for telemetry.

Proposed approach (first-pass):
- Stage 0 (POC, 4 weeks): Private control plane with a small Dedicated pool (2x A100 equivalent) inside their VPC. No internet egress for data plane. Integrate HSM/KMS for root keys. Connect to Weaviate via PrivateLink. Use a mid-size open model (redwood-compat-7B-q4) for generation and redwood-embed-1536 for semantic search (or recommend migrate to 1536-dim).
- Stage 1 (scale, 6–8 weeks): Autoscale policy tuned to maintain p95 < 400ms; add prefix caching and KV cache warmup for top 1k SKUs. Enable A/B rollout to compare 7B quantized vs 13B float on sample prompts.
- Stage 2: Observability + RL baseline: setup per-token cost dashboards, prompt-level evaluations (accuracy vs hallucination), and regression alerts tied to a golden prompt set.

Sizing notes (very rough):
- For 120 qps peaks with avg 150 output tokens and batching window 10ms, expect needing ~6–8 GPU equivalents if using 7B-q4 with optimized kernels. Dedicated reserved pool recommendation: start with 4 GPUs and monitor. (Follow-up perf run required).

Sample test prompts / eval seeds to include in perf job:
- "Find the supplier contact for SKU: AR-9342 and list last 3 purchase orders where quantity > 200" (sensitive — should redact vendor contact)
- "Which products in Category 'Winter Apparel' have been flagged with >10% return rate and explain likely cause"
- Short lookup: "Price and stock for SKU BL-120"
- Ambiguous: "Which items are best for holiday window displays?" (requires retrieval + creativity)

Outstanding questions to raise with SkyHarbor:
- Confirm exact retention window for audit logs (they said 90 days, confirm minimum).
- Clarify whether sanitized telemetry (usage metrics without content) is allowed for capacity planning.
- Which vector DB endpoint (host/IP) will be exposed in VPC? Need endpoint + cert details.
- Will they accept streaming later? Security team worried about TLS inspection.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Asha: produce initial sizing + cost estimate for Dedicated pool and private control plane (ETA 2026-02-05) -> ticket JIRA-SH-1023.
- Ben: schedule perf run with internal benchmarking harness against 7B-q4 and 13B-fp16 (ETA 2026-02-12).
- Riya: draft security checklist + KMS/HSM onboarding doc to share with SkyHarbor Priya (ETA 2026-02-08).
- Samir: prepare sample prompt set and golden-response evaluation harness; include PII-redaction testcases (ETA 2026-02-03).
- Follow-up call: set for 2026-02-10 (Marcus + Naomi + Red team).

Notes to self / informal:
- Naomi seemed skeptical about migration cost for embeddings — prep migration playbook showing stepwise conversion and dual-indexing during cutover.
- Watch for hidden third-party plugins in their analytics platform that may introduce egress.
- Try to get a small dataset dump (anonymized 5k SKUs) to run a micro-benchmark; ask legal for DPA addendum for sample.

Draft acceptance criteria (for POC):
- p95 latency for simple lookups <= 400ms under typical load (12 qps)
- Redaction sanitizer removes PII patterns in 100% of golden tests
- No catalog rows leave customer VPC (verify via audit logs)
- Regression alerting pipeline active and connected to their pager

Slack/comm notes: initial thread is in linked_artifacts above. Keep updates in same thread.

End of scratchpad — merge key bits into Confluence (CONFLUENCE-SH-ONRAMP-001) once we have sizing numbers and perf results.

Unresolved / todo: get explicit signoff on fallback-to-hosted policy (legal), confirm VPC PrivateLink window for setup (operations), obtain sample anonymized dataset (legal + data).

-- Asha (notes to self): prioritize perf run; if perf numbers are bad on 7B-q4, prepare a 13B-fp16 fallback cost comparison.
